One of my favorite places to hang out
Aug 2019 • Solo
I have been recommend many places to drink alone, but Irusu is definitely my fav one. 
Lovely and friendly staffs, not only did they tell me about the drinks, about the historical and other stuffs, they kept me company for the whole night although they were busy with their works and other customers. They always try to make the customers feel like home, a place to chill, not just a normal lounge or bar. They made me feel comfortable even when I went alone. 
For the price, the way they make the drinks is affordable and understandable for the price. In my opinion, it’s totally worth it. Imagine the place where all the bartenders are professional and skillful ones, I think spending a little bit money to enjoy your drinks will not be a problem. 
For the view, in the afternoon, the staff will guide you the rooftop where you can see the sunset over the Church which is lovely. I like sitting at the bar and looking everyone doing their jobs and talking, it’s kinda a guilty pleasure. 
Definitely will come back again. 
Worth trying and worth every pennies.
